title: Same Tree
summary: Return whether two trees have the same shape and value at every matching position.

contractDetails.constraints: Each tree has 0–100 nodes with integer values in [−10,000, 10,000].

statement: Return whether two trees have the same shape and value at every matching position. A left child must match a left child and a right child must match a right child.

examples.explanation: The same value occupies different child positions.

constraints: Each tree has 0–100 nodes with integer values in [−10,000, 10,000].
hints: Conceptual: The order of children matters even when their values are equal.
Directional: Walk both trees together, comparing corresponding nodes and missing children.
Implementation: Two nulls match. One null fails. Otherwise compare values and schedule the two corresponding child pairs.
complexityAnalysis: O(n+m) time and O(h) auxiliary space with a depth-first stack, where h is the larger tree height.
